notes: Each dimension min/max is a permitted world-space bounding-box SIZE, not an absolute minimum/maximum coordinate; units are metres, with 0.2 mm tolerance.

Closed entities should have positive signed volume and zero boundary/nonmanifold edges after the public compiler applies their modifier stacks. Cabinet and panel openings have wall thickness; their surfaces should remain closed.
The 150000 polygon budget includes every mesh, including invisible cavity, vent, grille-boundary and screw-slot operands. No operands are removed from this accounting.
Only top-button location.z changes: 0.175 at frame 1, 0.1743 at frame 24, 0.175 at frame 48. Every other product entity transform is invariant.
These are candidate-product checks. The explicitly simplified baseline is intentionally not required to satisfy them.
